'''{{PAGENAME}}''' is a [[Quests|Quest]] in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Dialogue==
{{quote|Soldier! I've got a new job that's right up your alley.I've come across something interesting. A new piece of weaponry. Nobody in Tarkov has seen anything like it before! How'd I get it? Trade secret.But I'll tell you this: the weapon definitely has potential. Still, you know as well as I do that all those specs and proving-ground reports don't mean shit until the thing gets tested in the field.So if you're interested in getting your hands on a truly unique weapon, we can help each other out. We'll sort out the payment. I won't leave you hanging.}}

==Objectives==
* Eliminate any 30 targets with an [[Aklys Defense Velociraptor .300 Blackout assault rifle|Aklys Defense Velociraptor]] on [[Lighthouse]] or [[The Lab]]

==Rewards==
* +65,000 [[EXP]]
* +4 [[Light Machine Guns|Light Machine Guns skill]] levels
* +4 [[Heavy Machine Guns|Heavy Machine Guns skill]] levels
* [[Prapor]] Rep <font color="green">'''+1.5'''</font>
* 400,000 Roubles
** 420,000 Roubles with [[Hideout#Modules|Intelligence Center]] Level 1
** 460,000 Roubles with [[Hideout#Modules|Intelligence Center]] Level 2
* 1× [[Kalashnikov AK-12 5.45x39 assault rifle]]
* 1× [[5.45x39mm BP gs ammo pack (120 pcs)]]
* Unlocks barter for [[Kalashnikov AK-12 5.45x39 assault rifle]] at [[Prapor]] LL4
* Unlocks craft for [[5.45x39mm BP gs]] at [[Hideout#modules|Workbench level 3]]
{{quote|So, it's good, you say? Well then, maybe I can raise the price a little, what do you think?}}
